resources.string: Sign-in communicates directly with Telegram. Sessions are encrypted on this device. Other cloud features remain in development; login does not certify full readiness.
Enter your API ID and API hash from my.telegram.org. Values are stored encrypted and are not displayed again.
API configuration saved. Access is validated when contacting Telegram.
End the AutoGram session on this device for %1$s? Other device sessions are not removed.
Telegram accepted the code request. Enter the code you receive.
This account requires its two-step verification password.
Open Telegram on a signed-in device → Settings → Devices → Link device. Scan this QR; do not share it.
Refreshing QR. Retry if the connection was interrupted.
API ID or API hash is invalid. Check your configuration.
The phone number is invalid or cannot be used.
Incorrect code. Check the latest code you received.
The login request expired. Cancel and start again.
Incorrect 2FA password. Try again without resending the OTP.
Telegram requires a cooldown. Further requests are held until it ends.
Encrypted storage could not be opened or saved. Data has not been automatically reset.
Telegram requires a step in its official app. Login has not been reported as successful.
The session is unauthorized or mismatched. Sign in again to the correct account.
Telegram connection failed or timed out. Check your network and retry.
Telegram has not allowed another code delivery.
The account operation did not succeed. Check your connection and try again.
